references.title: Testing the Performance of Face Recognition for People with Down Syndrome
references.support: Identity recognition fairness and image capture conditions; not a diagnostic geometric threshold model

references.title: Facial Analysis Systems and Down Syndrome
references.support: Commercial system bias, image conditions and transparent documentation; not a disease predictor

references.title: A Replication Study: Machine Learning Models Are Capable of Predicting Sexual Orientation From Facial Images
references.support: Discusses limits and uncertainty about morphology versus presentation; does not validate a personal geometric index

references.title: Challenges in Representation Learning: A report on three machine learning contests
references.support: FER2013 dataset and trained learning task; no handcrafted EAR/MAR-to-emotion formula

references.title: MediaPipe Face Landmarker official documentation
references.support: 478 face landmarks and 52 expression blendshape coefficients; single-frame visible output, not health/identity probabilities

measurement_definitions: Project-defined transparent 2D observations. No invented paper norms, diagnosis, cognition or sexual-orientation inference.
